transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello. ...I suppose I'm here because of some issues at work. I do translation work, and... well, for months now I’ve been seeing this same pattern in the project files. 

It’s... certain subcontractors. And one colleague in particular. They keep making these tiny changes to the translation memory, and the timestamps. Just... altering things so it looks like my quality control failed. I had IT look into it, and they claim the audit trail is clean, but... I know what I'm seeing. The record has been arranged to put the blame on me. 

So... that's what's been going on. I don't really know what else to say about it right now.
Even after IT told you the audit trail was clean, are you still certain your colleague is deliberately altering the records to make you look at fault?

...Yes. Like I just said, I know what I'm seeing. 

IT... they just look at the surface level. But I know my own work, and I know the translation memory was altered. It's subtle, but it's there. It's deliberately set up to make me look bad. IT missing it doesn't really change the fact that it's happening.
Have you been hearing voices when no one is there?
...No. No, I haven't. Just... normal office noise. Nothing like that.
Has it ever felt like someone can put thoughts into your mind?
...No. I don't... I don't know why you're asking me these things. Nobody is putting thoughts in my head. I'm just telling you what's happening with the files at work.
Do you generally find it hard to trust other people, even outside of work?

...No. Not really. I don't have a problem with people in general, if that's what you're getting at. I get along fine with people outside of the office. It's just... this one specific situation at work. That's all.
For at least one month, have you been convinced that your colleague was altering the records to make you look bad?
...Yes. It's... it's been about 11 months now. Basically since I was put in charge of the new localization project. That's when it started.
Have other people told you that your speech is hard to follow or that you jump from one idea to another in a way that doesn’t make sense to them?
...No. People understand me just fine. My work requires me to be very precise with language, so... no. Nobody has ever said that to me.
During this time, have you had a period when you felt unusually high or unusually depressed most of the day?
...No. I haven't. Just... normal, I guess. I don't have any issues like that.
Have you noticed that you've become less interested in things you used to care about?
...No. Not really. I still do the things I usually do. My interests haven't changed.
Have you become emotionally flat or less expressive than you used to be?
...No. I don't think so. I'm just... myself. I haven't noticed anything like that.
Do you believe your colleague has any special ability or impossible method to alter the files without leaving any trace?
...No. Nothing like that. It's not... magic or anything impossible. He just knows his way around the system, I suppose. That's all.
